const sent =
  $('Prepare Sent Tracker Update')
    .first()
    ?.json ?? {};

return [
  {
    json: {
      success: true,

      send_status:
        'SENT',

      message:
        'Approved outreach email sent successfully.',

      opportunity_key:
        sent.opportunity_key,

      contact_email:
        sent.contact_email,

      sent_at:
        sent.sent_at,

      follow_up_date:
        sent.follow_up_date,

      response_status:
        sent.response_status,

      gmail_message_id:
        sent.gmail_message_id,

      gmail_thread_id:
        sent.gmail_thread_id,
    },
  },
];
